reviews.text: Everyone that works at Society Hill are fantastic. They actually care about their furry patients! Would highly recommend bringing your pet here!
the friendliest and kindest office ever. they all obviously love animals, and also are very nice to humans.

Been taking my dog here for years! He’s older and needs special care. They are always willing to work with my budget and meet his needs. I recommend this place to everyone I know with pets. Please take your animals here; they’re in good hands.

Went in for second opinion on my English bulldog came in and examining my boy gave me an opinion of what it seems to be immediately did some testing got results received medication and recommendation and went back for a second visit received a list of special surgeon if I decided to go that route the doctor was excellent highly recommend this veterinarian.
all staff, doctors and technicians are informed and caring and take the time to explain what's going on with your pet.
We are so happy with the care our sweet doggie receives at Society Hill and highly recommend them.

Society Hill Vets is more than just a clinic it’s a home-never had a veterinarian or staff proactively reach out to me after visits or interventions to check on my dogs. Super responsive, easy to contact, always able to fit us in. Love love love them. Highly recommend.
It was fast and easy.i was approved in minuets and was able to get my fur baby the care they so desperately needed. Don't know what I'd have done with out them.
Their team is so caring and compassionate towards my anxious husky. I highly recommend all of the vets and especially the tech Leeanne
Your positive feedback is greatly appreciated!

This team always goes above and beyond to provide exceptional care for our dog, Cooper. Special shout out to Dr. Shirosky, Syed, and Leeanne for their expertise and compassion. I would highly recommend this practice to anyone in the area.

Dusty, my cat, gets such wonderful care at SHVH.  The receptionist, technicians and doctors are friendly, gentle and very thorough when examining Dusty.  The doctor answers any questions and I never feel like my visit is rushed.  Definitely the best place ever
Staff are super friendly and vets are great

I've been a customer forever
SHVH really cares for our fur babies

We are always so pleased with the services provided at Society Hill Vet hospital for our Vito. The staff is so kind and caring. Vito is showered with love and he's all about it. We know that he is in great hands when we go there no matter what it is for. I cannot recommend this place enough.

Fabulous from the first call with Vivienne to my interaction with the nurse, assistants and of course the Doctor.  I really loved and appreciated my welcome package that included toys and treats for Sammi.

I just switched from a vet that I was with for almost 19 years to SHVH and couldn't be happier. Every single person I dealt with was friendly, professional and on top of everything.
I am really happy I switched!

Everyone from the office staff to the Dr were very kind and made great efforts to keep my dog calm and answer any questions I had Regarding my dog's care. I would definitely recommend society Hill veterinary Hospital.

Efficient and compassionate service from the person at the desk to the wellness check throughout. And, for cat owners,  please note that Saed, the vet nurse,  is the ultimate cat whisperer. My neurotic, fearful of the vet, aggressive during vet visit cat  just lay there happily with her eyes closed and at ease (while she got two shots and a needle aspiration of a lump) simply because he was holding and soothing her. Very impressive. Great experience for both my cat and me.
They did a great job with the cat, fixed her hypertension and blindness caused by it. Amazing!!
Thank you for your positive rating! We're delighted to know you had a great experience with us.

BEST VET EXPERIENCE EVER. My 1 y/o dog went for an initial visit for routine services and Dr. Bujanda and her whole staff including reception were so kind, caring, and thorough.  Dr. Bujanda provided the expected services but also went above and beyond and provided education on preventative care measures for my dog including ear and teeth hygiene which I really appreciated. I was impressed by the whole positive vibe/atmosphere in the office. My dog had a great experience and honestly is probably excited for the next visit because she got so much attention and treats for her vaccines.

I had a wonderful experience at Society Hill Vet! From the initial phone call to meeting the friendly and thoughtful staff and my awesome Dr. I would highly recommend this hospital to anyone with a beloved pet. As a new resident I am so grateful to have found them!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're so happy to know you had a positive experience with us!
Great people. Great service. The pup loves going. :)
Always professional, courteous, and caring.
Wonderful, kind, competent staff. Everyone in that building is amazing. They care about my cats like they’re their own.
All staff: the tech, receptionist and doctor were kind and friendly and explained everything well
They truly care about my pets and even check on the owners.I  have been taking my pets to Society Hill for 22 years.Need I  say more? I wouldn’t keep going back if they weren’t the best!
Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a 5-Star review!
We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us!
Thank you for taking the time out of your day to leave us 5 stars! 💫💫💫 …

4/26..recently had to bring out cat in and I met Dr. Shirosky for the first time.  She went above and beyond in assisting us with our cat.  Many thanks to her, Diana and Valencia for all their kindness.

We took our pet to this place when it was first adopted.  Due to life sometimes getting super busy, our wellness visits were not up to date.  I was very happy to know, our pets records were kept and we were able to
schedule a well visit.  I like the fact that they
give you a "Preventive Report" which gives you services rendered, exam findings and recommendations.  Due to COVID, you can't go into the office; but, they do come out to your car and pick up your pet.  Our pet was seen by Dr. Wallis and he phones you while you are there with any concerns.  Very happy with their service.  Thank you!

Update 6/29/24…We had to take Miss Marple, in for a visit and was greeted by Diana and Nicole, who have always been so supportive and helpful over the phone.  We saw Dr Warren and met with additional techs, who were so very kind and helpful.  Miss Marple is doing well, thank you for your kindness during our visit.  I had to reschedule a visit and I have to mention, Maya, thank you for your kindness!
I feel safe bringing my doggie here everyone is wonderful from the front desk to the doctors
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review!

We are so glad we switched to Society Hill Vets for the care of our shiba. They made the process of transferring records easy. Everyone there is so caring and professional.  When our shiba was vomiting and in distress, they got us in quickly for testing and planning next steps. We are  impressed with how gentle and thorough the staff and vet are in administering tests and recommending treatment.They easily got our dog to stand on a weight scale (1st time in 7 years!). They advised us of costs upfront and gave clear after-care advice. There are several free adjacent parking spaces  for visitors.
